notes: Both ben baqar pairs are fused under rule 30's one-English-word condition, each headed on ben, which carries the sense young; par keeps its own bullock.
minchah heads on meal and chattath on sin by rule 31's subtraction; heading either on offering was the available competing reading, since the ASV writes offering for both.
The assimilated article of va-shshamen has no the written for it and is unrepresented (rule 12).
